var_protocol_note: This file contains only VAR-reviewable decisions according to FIFA/IFAB protocol: Goals, Penalties, Red Cards, and Mistaken Identity. Yellow cards and other non-VAR incidents are excluded.

var_decision.note: Bruno Guimaraes (Brazil) steps up to the penalty spot. He attempts to confuse the goalkeeper by stopping in the middle of his run up and sends the ball to the right side of the target, but Orjan Nyland keeps his cool to thwart him.
GOAL! Neymar (Brazil) sends the penalty kick into the right of the net.
